children: Producer prices in Norway soared by 30.1% year-on-year in August 2026, accelerating from 23.4% in the previous month.

It marked the highest reading since September 2022, driven by broad-based increases across major sub-indices, including extraction of oil and natural gas (52.1% vs 38.2% in July), manufacturing (7.9% vs 6.4%), electricity, gas and steam (57.9% vs 41%), and energy goods (53.2% vs 39.8%).
Excluding energy goods, producer price growth edged up to 5.4% from 5.3% in July.
By market, producer prices in the domestic market rose to 11.9% from 10%, while export market prices climbed to 41.4% from 31%.
On a monthly basis, producer price growth eased to 4.7% in August from a four-month high of 8.9% in July.

title: Norway Producer Inflation Hits Near 4-Year High
